extracted.name: Easy Cranberry Salad
extracted.description: Sweetened fresh cranberries are folded into whipped cream with crushed pineapple, chopped pecans and tiny marshmallows.
instruction_lines: Coarsely chop the cranberries in a food processor; put in a large, non-metal bowl and mix in the sugar. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours.
Whip the cream until stiff. Add the pineapple and nuts to the cranberries, mix well. Fold in whipped cream and marshmallows; refrigerate until ready to serve.
